cues: Reactions span an astonishing range of speeds.
Ionic reactions, like silver nitrate with salt, or acid with alkali, finish in a millionth of a second.
Coal takes millions of years to form.
In between, in minutes to hours, sit reactions like the decomposition of hydrogen peroxide, the ones we can actually follow in a laboratory.
text: Reactions span an astonishing range of speeds. Ionic reactions, like silver nitrate with salt, or acid with alkali, finish in a millionth of a second. Rusting takes years. Coal takes millions of years to form. In between, in minutes to hours, sit reactions like the decomposition of hydrogen peroxide, the ones we can actually follow in a laboratory.
